title: Retire Antigravity from active AI Command Center surfaces
description: Operator decision: remove Antigravity from the AI Command Center active roster because its token limit makes it unusable. Retire Antigravity from fresh-start Command Center Lab tabs, active launcher prompts, Command Center CLI/shell advertising and launch/status/log paths, and MAP active agent availability. Preserve historical task/review artifacts and generic hcom provider support outside Command Center. Replace Antigravity assignments in the reviewed research-adoption plan with suitable Codex/Claude/Pi/Librarian routing, add focused tests, and record deployment/rollback evidence for live install drift.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh AI Command Center Lab startup surfaces open only Codex, Claude, Pi, and Librarian; no Antigravity tab is auto-started in the canonical template or live installed lab wezterm configuration.
Installed Codex, Claude, Pi, and Librarian lab prompts no longer name Antigravity as part of the fixed visible startup roster or active coordination set.

Command Center CLI/shell help, banners, start/status/log behavior, and active launcher scripts no longer advertise or launch Antigravity as an active Command Center agent; generic hcom Antigravity provider support outside Command Center is preserved.

The canonical MAP agent record and mirrored status mark antigravity unavailable/retired or equivalent non-routable state through the authority path; graph/runner.py no longer lists antigravity as available for active routing.

The reviewed research-adoption implementation plan no longer assigns work to Antigravity; its four Antigravity assignments are replaced with suitable Codex, Claude, Pi, Librarian, or local-helper routing without adding unreviewed authority.
Focused tests or validation checks cover the changed launcher/CLI/status behavior, and task mirrors plus shared-state validators pass after the change.
A deployment/rollback evidence artifact records source changes, live install updates on the relevant host(s), verification commands, and rollback steps.
Historical tasks, reviews, events, and archived Antigravity evidence are preserved; do not delete generic provider wrappers unless they are specifically Command Center active-surface shims.
